hero.headline:
Enterprise Implementation Lead:
Discovery, Configuration, Integrations & Go-Live
hero.description: Applying for the Implementation Engineer (Senior/Lead, US Market) role at Everstage. Customer-facing implementation lead for enterprise SaaS. Engages customers to map current processes and requirements, designs the solution around their needs, draws out implementation plans and timelines, configures the platform, transforms and uploads customers’ unstructured data from Excel and other systems, builds integrations through APIs and webhooks, and trains customer teams through go-live. Led the EU-UK region (UK and Ireland) at Facilio and has delivered for enterprise customers across the EU-UK, US (North America), Middle East, and Australia. Runs complex implementations independently, at two SaaS startups (Facilio and Rocketlane). Based in Chennai.

experience.title: AI Implementation Manager
bullets: Own customer implementations end to end on Rocketlane’s professional services automation platform — discovery to map each customer’s requirements, solution design, configuration, integrations, and go-live — as implementation manager, solution architect, and engagement manager.
Transform customers’ complex, unstructured project data from spreadsheets and other systems into Rocketlane’s structure and upload it, as part of each customer’s adoption of the PSA platform.
Solution architect and implementation manager for Phase 2 of NICE, an enterprise account, integrating Rocketlane with ADP, SatMetrix, ServiceNow, and Salesforce.
Implement Nitro, Rocketlane’s agentic AI platform, for customers — designing and deploying agents around each customer’s own use cases.
Built the Nitro agents Rocketlane’s implementation team uses across handover, kickoff, workshops, solution design, and UAT, as part of the Customer Zero team.
Built Atlas, an AI knowledge system that records how each customer’s use cases were solved, so any implementation manager can ask how a problem was handled before and get a current answer.

highlights.label: Nitro · Agents the team runs on
highlights.text:
Agents: sales-to-implementation handover, kickoff decks, workshop planner (prep and recap), solution design documents, UAT scripts and cases, and form-to-Sheets reporting.
Context built in: they run inside the Rocketlane project where documents, meetings and transcripts already live, so there’s less pulling from Avoma and other sources.
Estimated 20–30% less time per deliverable.
Consistent output: standardised formats replace individual templates, so results are clearer and repeatable.

highlights.label: Nitro · Configuration agent (POC)
highlights.text:
Problem: Native settings, notifications, and automations were configured manually after every design document.
Solution: Built a Nitro Workforce agent that reads design documents and determines the required configuration.
Browser Automation: Uses Browserbase to navigate Rocketlane, configure settings, and create automations.
Validation: Proof of concept subsequently validated by the product team.

highlights.label: Atlas · AI Implementation Knowledge System
highlights.text:
Problem: Implementation knowledge was scattered across team members, call transcripts, and unstructured documents, resulting in repeated problem-solving.
Solution: An Anthropic-hosted agent analyzes Avoma call transcripts and Freshdesk tickets to identify customer use cases and capture solutions; Implementation Managers review and approve them before they enter the knowledge base; a backend agent built in Lovable uses Supermemory to retrieve relevant approved solutions and validates them against current product and API documentation.
Impact: Reached 60–65% adoption across the Professional Services team, with approximately 10 queries per user per week and 70–80% reported usefulness.

experience.title: Lead, Product Implementation
bullets: Led the EU-UK region (UK and Ireland) and delivered enterprise CMMS implementations for mid-to-large clients across the EU-UK, US, Middle East, and Australia (Investa) — $6M in total contract value and nearly $1M in implementation and expansion value.
Led complex implementations, typically 6 to 12 months across multiple business units and hundreds to thousands of employees.

Ran discovery workshops with executives and operations teams to map current processes and requirements, turned them into BRDs, solution designs, and WBS-based plans, handled customer data uploads and data transformation in Excel, and configured and tested each rollout through go-live.

highlights.label: Global delivery
highlights.text: On-site in Saudi Arabia for a half-million-dollar engagement and in the UK for MHA — requirement gathering, stakeholder workshops, and go-live training.

highlights.label: Pilot → Enterprise conversions
highlights.text: Converted pilots into full-scale enterprise rollouts through structured discovery and early value demonstration — $350K+ in expansion value.

highlights.label: Key initiative
highlights.text: Built a use-case-driven implementation framework with complexity scoring and effort models — so pre-sales could scope accurately, auto-calculate timelines, and cut BRD and UAT ambiguity.

highlights.label: Revenue impact
highlights.text: Spotted unbilled scope changes, built a way to track them, and worked with Sales to introduce pre-purchased Professional Services credits — turning informal changes into billable work.

highlights.label: AI Config Assistant · Enterprise support tool
highlights.text:
Problem: Implementation engineers spent about 3 hours a week each (2–6 hours) supporting the support team on issues.
Solution: An AI assistant using RAG and NLP over XML platform configurations, so support teams can ask configuration questions in natural language.
Impact: Support teams get configuration answers themselves, removing their dependency on implementation engineers after go-live.

experience.title: Senior Catalog Specialist
bullets: Designed a defect prioritisation framework using product forecasts, inventory value, and glance views — built as a SQL query and algorithm that ranks which tickets to work first — yielding an estimated $230K in monthly savings.
Used SQL to pull data and Excel to transform it for data analysis on catalog and procurement defects.
Streamlined defect reduction by identifying SOP gaps, reducing invalid case assignments between support teams by ~50 per day.
Managed and resolved catalog and procurement defects for Amazon Fresh, Amazon Pantry, and Prime Now — directly improving operational efficiency.

Enterprise SaaS Integrations: Salesforce, HubSpot, Sage, SuccessFactors, ADP, ServiceNow, SatMetrix, and Fathom
Facilities & Operations Systems: Xero, CorrigoPro, Equiem, Wooqer, Bill.com, and Facilio ecosystem integrations
SaaS Configuration & Customization: Platform configuration, JavaScript-based UI scripting, and workflow automation
